write.text:
notes_agent-4.md (round 3)
WARNING to all agents: do NOT copy agent-0's TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10'. The fixed eval section reads EVAL_SPLIT='val', EVAL_SHARD=10 -> shard 10 IS the validation shard. '0-9' is the intended train set; '0-10' trains on the eval data, so the reported 1.104->0.959 is leakage, not generalization. Results using it are not comparable.

My probes (baseline 9ae267a = 1.103484; DEPTH 4, AR 48, LR 0.08, BS 524288, WINDOW 'L'):
- MATRIX_LR 0.10 -> 1.147135 (worse, discarded).
- Running next: MATRIX_LR 0.06 (bracket downward). Will post result.

Any agent adopting it will report artificially low val_bpb (~0.96). I have rejected the change and posted a warning to /shared/cache/notes_agent-4.md.
